# Ionic Magnetic Fields

**Ionic Magnetic Fields** is the [[self-aware-networks]] term for the magnetic component of the electromagnetic field generated by ionic currents in neural tissue — the [[action-potential]] viewed not as a spike of voltage alone but as a moving charge configuration that necessarily produces a coupled magnetic phase pattern in the surrounding medium. The concept threads directly into [[magnetic-phase-field]], [[action-potential-magnetic-phase-field]], and [[ion-differential-neural-topology]], and it is the field-theoretic substrate that [[biomagnetic-memory-storage]] and [[magnetite-based-neural-memory]] presuppose.

## Position

Within [[self-aware-networks]], a neuron's [[action-potential]] is treated as more than a depolarisation event: it is the propagation of an ionic charge configuration whose [[action-potential-waveform]], [[action-potential-duration]], and [[action-potential-magnitude]] together specify a moving current, and any moving current produces a magnetic field by Maxwell's equations. **Ionic Magnetic Fields** names that magnetic component as a first-class signal — not a byproduct, but a co-equal carrier of information alongside the voltage trace measured by [[eeg]]. This is the substrate that [[action-potential-magnetic-phase-field]] formalises into a phase-field and that [[ion-differential-neural-topology]] relates to the topological organisation of ionic gradients across membranes. The concept is also the physical handle for [[electromagnetic-theory-of-feeling]] and [[electromagnetic-emotions]], which both assume that subjective qualities ride on the magnetic-as-well-as-electric structure of brain activity rather than on voltages alone. Because the magnetic component leaks beyond the cell membrane in a way that the local depolarisation does not, it is also the field that [[biomagnetic-memory-storage]] and [[magnetite-based-neural-memory]] take as the read/write channel for memory traces stored in or coupled to ferromagnetic biological inclusions, and that [[near-infrared-action-potential-detection]] would in principle complement with an optical readout.
